types.description: Provisional generic two-position maintained selector with one NO contact: open in position 0, closed in position 1.

connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: Single pair 13/14 is required; position 0 is the declared normal state (open), position 1 closes the maintained contact. Position retention is descriptive, not simulated. Optional: none in this interface. Unmodeled: extra poles/positions, illumination and bonding. Select hardware and add applicable ratings; markings are a generic convention, not a manufacturer pinout.
